environment: Windows 11 Home (10.0.26200), 32 logical cores. In-app Chromium browser pane: ANGLE / NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 (D3D11). Headless Google Chrome 152.0.7977.83 with SwiftShader (software WebGL). Local static server (python http.server). Measured 2026-09-13 after the architecture, landscape, streetscape and stability revision.

tests.name: Geometry + program audit (tools/hero3d/audit.mjs)
tests.result: all scripted checks pass (see section 1), including penthouse basins, office crown and garage, canopy clearances and the coplanar-surface scan

tests.name: Coplanar-surface scan (tools/hero3d/coplanar.mjs)
tests.settings: masses, curved caps, slab and ring annuli, instanced parts; 12 mm tolerance; downward faces skipped
tests.result: before the revision: office block roofs vs roof bands (≈ 1,055 / 626 / 262 m²), tower and penthouse roof caps vs top slabs, hotel roof caps vs cornices, sidewalk and path joint strips 6 mm above paving, driveway aprons 5 mm above sidewalks; after: 0 overlapping visible surfaces on desktop and mobile

tests.name: Depth-tie flicker test, real GPU
tests.settings: hero pose S 0.92, canvas 1335 × 818; camera fixed, near plane perturbed ±3 % over 6 renders so screen positions are identical and only depth precision changes; pixels differing by > 10 RGB counted
tests.result: previous published model (near 10 m): 7,383 pixels; revised model at its shipping clipping range: 36 pixels (6,112 before the edge-pass polygon offset was added); revised model forced to a 10 m near plane: 368. Mobile tier (487 × 945 canvas): 5 pixels. The remaining pixels are sub-pixel line overlays on the ground.

tests.name: Desktop hero, real GPU (in-app browser)
tests.settings: 1350 × 910 CSS px, DPR 1, canvas 1335 × 818, shadows on (2048 map), S = 0.92
tests.result: 140 draw calls; ≈ 217,000 triangles; 18 shader programs; ≈ 1–2 ms CPU per frame after warm-up (first frame including shader compilation ≈ 50–70 ms); 0 frames rendered over 3 s idle; no runtime errors

tests.name: Mobile tier, emulated in the in-app browser
tests.settings: 390 × 844 CSS px emulation (DPR cap 1.25 → canvas 487 × 945), shadows off, reduced fins / plants / curve segments
tests.result: 112 draw calls; ≈ 147,000 triangles; ≈ 1.7 ms CPU per frame on the desktop GPU (NOT representative of a phone); first frame ≈ 550 ms including shader compilation; 0 idle frames

tests.name: Interaction stability, real GPU
tests.settings: normal page (no frozen S): slow scroll through the track, instant jump to mid-track, drag-rotate with release coast, viewport resize to 1100 × 760
tests.result: no runtime errors; S settles and clamps (0.7041 held over 3 s); drag coast settles and rendering stops (0 idle frames after 2.5 s); resize re-fits and then idles (0 frames); near / far follow the orbit distance

tests.name: Animation states (headless)
tests.result: grid and footprints → rising wireframes → materialise (wave screen and office garage arrive with their buildings) → final composition; no missing or floating elements observed

tests.name: Rotated views (headless)
tests.result: south-east, north-east and north-west views show the office garage façade, crown terrace, hotel service side and both penthouse terraces without gaps or intersections

tests.name: Mobile hero framing (headless + in-app)
tests.result: model fitted below the hero copy at every size; the M.R.E.D.+U. line is clear of the model

tests.name: Hero-camera visibility (ray-marched, audit)
tests.settings: desktop key frame S 0.92; mobile camera travel 0.55

tests.name: Revision: finished-model clean-up, hotel garden, penthouse layout, vehicle entrances, park sculpture
tests.settings: audit desktop + mobile tiers; headless SwiftShader renders at S 0.45 and 0.92 (hero, park, hotel garden, both penthouses, residential and office entrances, mobile 430 px); in-app browser real GPU at S ≈ 0.88
tests.result: 161/161 scripted checks pass, including the new penthouse layout check (every group inside the glass guard, off the glass walk and the basins, no clashes) and the coplanar scan; construction grid and linework visible during the build (S 0.45) and absent on the finished model (S 0.92); real GPU: 118 draw calls, ≈ 242,000 triangles, < 1 ms CPU per frame, no new runtime errors. Idle-frame count not re-measured: the pane was receiving pointer movement (parallax) during the check.

notPerformed: No physical phone or tablet was tested. Mobile results above come from desktop emulation and headless Chrome and are not device validation.
No low-end or integrated GPU was tested; SwiftShader renders confirm correctness only, not performance.
No Safari / iOS WebKit or Firefox testing.
No thermal, battery or long-session memory testing.
No accessibility audit of the page beyond reduced-motion behaviour; curve ramps and tactile strips are representational, not checked against accessibility standards.
Frame times are display-refresh limited on the test machine; GPU frame cost under load was not profiled.
Reduced-motion and no-WebGL fallbacks were not re-run after this revision (they are unchanged code paths).
